description:
Hi,This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 Job Title: Oracle / Java Developer 
 Duration: 12 Months 
 Location: PENNINGTON, NJ 
 Job Description: 
 Description:  Oracle / Java Developer with strong background in data modeling, writing stored procedures, and other database concepts. Must be detailed oriented and able to partner with other members of the development team. 
Must Have: Oracle Database with Java experience preferred
Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you. 
 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person for this job as well. Hope to hear from you soon.



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
